verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a large destination catalog of 200+ third-party tools and cloud destinations. Its Transformations feature lets you filter, enrich, and reshape events before they reach destinations, and community users say routing 'just works'. The evidence does not show that mapping and filtering can be scoped per destination; it only says transformations run before events reach destinations. missing for 10: explicit per-destination mapping/filtering configuration, documented field-mapping UI per destination, independent hands-on corroboration of mapping depth.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can route events to a large catalog of documented destination integrations with per-destination mapping and filtering

citations.quote: Send your events to 200+ third-party tools and platforms
Transformations let you filter, enrich, and reshape event data before it reaches your destinations.
Instrument one RudderStack SDK and automatically send standardized data to hundreds of destinations
